training.precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 disabled; FP32 CPU fallback
training.loss: Answer token plus EOS, shifted causal CE, other targets ignored; same two supervised tokens/example in both encodings.
training.length_schedule: Uniform permutations of n6/7/8, repeated/truncated to20k; final counts differ by<=1.
training.batch_schedule: Fixed64 distinct graph anchors at the scheduled n; same saved table and start RNG for all4 models.
training.endpoint: Fixed final20k update checkpoint; no best-checkpoint or early-stopping selection.
training.execution: Single GPU, serial jobs; no concurrent step0 creation. Resume only when protocol/data/start hashes agree.

starting_rng_origin: Actual archived TF descents starting Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA states, copied once and shared across all4 new graph tasks; no same-seed identity assumption.

data.sampling: Uniform p-category draw, independent off-diagonal Bernoulli edges, global full<R,C,W> orbit rejection in train/validation/analysis order; all accidental wrong-label matches retained.

serialization.prefix: BOS SIZE n ARG_START; row-major non-diagonal00/01, existing| between rows; ARG_END
serialization.reused_token_semantics: Graph-specific serializer and task token meanings; original permutation parser untouched. Existing random token IDs are reinterpreted, no new vocabulary.

evaluation.strata: Joint[n,left identity,mapped right identity/correct/wrong], independently>=3 in fit/test; density adds exact anchor edge count m. Masks fixed across all models/branches.
evaluation.input_kernel: Position-wise binary two-class onehot, exact common Gram under fixed slot/category isometries; static input reference, no fabricated initialization/training Delta.
evaluation.procrustes_similarity: negative held-out RMS normalized error; larger is more similar
evaluation.undefined_policy: NaN/None retained; fixed1/3 aggregate undefined if any n missing, never reweighted.

engineering.supervision: Independent mask/shifted CE, finite nonzero gradient, changed parameter, task/EOS scores retained; no accuracy threshold.

limitations: Four relationships share four tasks and two transformations; not4 independent mathematical replications.
One graph world and one shared initialization; configuration-specific exploratory transfer across systems.
Vertex relabeling/isomorphism classes are not excluded, only the specified<R,C,W> orbits.
Different size/encoding/task/distribution from PermWorld; no domain-only causal contrast.
